name: com.corpusfetch/corpusfetch
title: CorpusFetch
description: O(1) symptom routing, semantic search, and warrant-first fetch over 700+ concluded records.

tools.name: corpusfetch_lookup_exception
tools.description: Route a Python exception class to candidate record addresses.

tools.name: corpusfetch_lookup_symptom
tools.description: Route a runtime symptom key to candidate record addresses.

tools.name: corpusfetch_search
tools.description: Search the corpus by natural language keywords or concepts.

tools.name: corpusfetch_fetch_warrant
tools.description: Fetch the ~220-token precondition seal. Call before the record.

tools.name: corpusfetch_fetch_record
tools.description: Fetch the record body: .md (~1500 tokens) or .py (~300 tokens).
